items.question: Did Jordan Harrison play in the WNBA?
items.answer: Yes. Jordan Harrison played the 2026 season for the Portland Fire, appearing in 16 games with two starts. Portland signed her in April, waived her on May 11, brought her back on a developmental contract on May 21 and converted her to a standard contract on August 9. She announced her retirement from basketball in late September 2026.

items.question: Where did Jordan Harrison play college basketball?
items.answer: Jordan Harrison played one season at Stephen F. Austin and three at West Virginia. At WVU she was the 2026 Big 12 Defensive Player of the Year and a First-Team All-Big 12 pick, and her 110 steals in one season are the second most in school history.

items.question: What are Jordan Harrison's stats?
items.answer: In the 2026 regular season, Jordan Harrison averaged 5.1 points, 1.8 rebounds, and 4.2 assists in 16 games for the Portland Fire.

items.question: Was Jordan Harrison drafted?
items.answer: No. Jordan Harrison went undrafted in 2026 and signed with the Portland Fire during training camp.

items.question: How tall is Jordan Harrison?
items.answer: The WNBA lists Jordan Harrison at 5 feet 6 inches and 132 pounds.
